title: Chapter 339: The War Of Destruction
content:
Chapter 339: The War Of Destruction

"You are not qualified to talk to me about the distribution of benefits!"

"You pseudo-gods who use evil magic, normal people don't even bother to associate with you!"

"This world is not something you can divide up now!"

Wu Qing laughed with some disdain.

"Hahaha! You really don't know how high the sky is and how deep the earth is!"

"Then let me see how capable you are!"

The Spiritual God was not angry after hearing Wu Qing's words. He laughed loudly and the world collapsed with one move!

It seemed that the vast territory of the Spiritual God's Kingdom was instantly transformed into nothingness. The will of the world's rules had huge fluctuations. Outside the entire scope of the Spiritual God's Kingdom, there were endless lightning, preventing the continued destruction of the Spiritual God's Kingdom!

Wu Qing didn't expect that the Spiritual God would not attack him, but attack this world instead, but he was not worried. With the strength of the Spiritual God, he could not shake the foundation of this world.

This kind of attack in the Kingdom of God is indeed a means that the strong in this world cannot use, and it is very powerful.

Wu Qing unfolded his own domain and instantly moved near the domain of the Spiritual God's Kingdom. The will of the world's rules took the initiative to make way for him.

Wu Qing went straight into the realm of the Kingdom of the Spirit God, and eroded the realm of the Kingdom of the Spirit God with the power of the realm!

With the support of the will of the rules of this world, Wu Qing's realm power was unstoppable and broke the realm of the Kingdom of the Spirit God!

Wherever Wu Qing passed, with the assistance of the will of the rules of the world, mountains and rivers appeared in the void!

Wu Qing's realm became larger and larger, constantly compressing the coverage of the Kingdom of the Spirit God, sacrificing the powerful force brought in by the clan, and constantly consuming it in this kind of no-frills realm confrontation.

The external power obtained by trickery is ultimately water without a source, and there will always be a time when it will run out.

And Wu Qing's true body is in this world, and he has the help of this world. His power is almost endless, and he is least afraid of such power consumption.

"I didn't expect you to use your power so skillfully!"

"The will of this world seems to trust you very much!"

"No wonder you have the confidence to shout!"

"However, the power of the outside world is something you can never imagine!"

"I can let you feel it in advance!"

The spirit god said, and a terrible white light flew out from his body, breaking Wu Qing's domain power all the way, and instantly flew to Wu Qing's side!

This is a rule power that Wu Qing cannot understand. This kind of rule power can cause great damage to him!

An extremely vast spiritual power descended, breaking all laws with one force, and directly used powerful spiritual power to forcefully break the rule power contained in the white light!

The Queen of Insects joined the battle!

It broke the terrible blow that Wu Qing could not resist with its unimaginable spiritual power!

When the power is strong to a certain extent, any rule power can be broken with one force!

"There are still such strong people!"

"Not bad!"

"It seems that it is difficult to take over this world peacefully. Let me show you what means are!"

After the spirit god finished speaking, Wu Qing felt that a familiar and terrible force had entered this world!

This should not be the power of the spirit god, but the terrible power of the mysterious force behind the spirit god!

After discovering that this power was eroding this world, Wu Qing and the Queen of Insects made a full-scale attack, "Boom!" and shattered the realm of the kingdom of the spirit god!

The powerful energy clone of the spirit god shattered and disappeared in this attack, and also could not escape the energy conversion and absorption of the system!

The terrible power that launched the beast tide in the world of the birth of weirdness and the system's affiliated world appeared in this world again under the operation of the spirit god!

The will of the world rules is like a cat with its fur blown up, and it launched a counterattack against this force regardless of everything!

The various negative forces in this world, irradiated by the terrible power, immediately underwent tremendous changes, forming various strange monsters, devouring all the surrounding matter and energy!

The Queen's spiritual power was finally released, and the whole world was shrouded by its powerful spiritual power. It seemed to have become the will of the second world rules!

That terrible power can blend with everything, and even the will of the world rules cannot be eliminated. With the current strength of Wu Qing and the Queen of Insects, it cannot be directly eliminated.

But Wu Qing has a system. He can indirectly eliminate the terrible power by eliminating the terrible power and integrating the material and energy evolution of this world!

That power is very magical. It is not aggressive in itself. It depends on the fusion of other substances and energies to give birth to new species to destroy the world.

Even if the rules and native creatures of this world can eliminate those new species, it will not lose a trace of mysterious terrible power!

You are the weirdness of this world. For this world, this mysterious power is an unsolvable attack that will continue to erode this world until this world is destroyed.

The mysterious power that gave birth to the weirdness before was not too strong. The forces behind it did not want to destroy this world directly. What they wanted was to completely occupy this world.

Now that they have found Wu Qing as a variable, and that all the gentle means have no effect, they have decisively used the ultimate means. If this world can no longer support and is destroyed, they will also have certain gains.

Therefore, the mysterious power invested in this world this time is more powerful than the power that gave birth to the weirdness, and countless terrible monsters were born in this world in an instant!

The strength of those monsters all starts at seven-star strength, and there are countless powerful ones. If these monsters were placed in the past, the entire local camp would not be able to defeat them!

The creatures of this world are extremely desperate in the face of these monsters!

The will of the rules of this world is also crazy. It is willing to mobilize its power to destroy these monsters at the cost of continued damage to its origin!

The whole world has become a sea of lightning, and countless lightning bolts fall from the sky and fall on those powerful monsters!

But all this is in vain. The dead monsters overflow with mysterious and terrible power, and absorb all kinds of substances and energy in this world again, giving birth to monsters!

"Suppress them! Let us attack!"

Wu Qing tried to communicate with the will of the world's rules. He clearly felt that the original power of this world was rapidly weakening.

If the fight continues like this, this world will soon collapse!

The will of the world's rules chose to believe Wu Qing. The lightning that permeated the entire world disappeared and turned into countless light nets, dividing and restricting those powerful monsters!

Wu Qing, the Queen of Zerg and all the forces of the Zerg and Protoss all went out to launch a fierce attack on the monsters that were restricted by the will of the world rules and consumed a lot of original power!

The Queen of Zerg's spiritual power enveloped the world, and the monsters with weaker strength all over the world collapsed and disappeared under its spiritual power!

Wherever Wu Qing passed, the monsters in the area calculated by thousands of miles instantly turned into light and disappeared silently!

The strong men of the Zerg and Protoss used their own powerful means to quickly kill the enemies everywhere!

The ordinary soldiers of the Zerg and Protoss also attacked with all their strength, using their numerical advantages to encircle and annihilate the powerful monsters!

The mysterious and terrible power contained in the monsters destroyed by Wu Qing and his forces was absorbed and transformed by the system and turned into a huge amount of system resources!

The bases of the Zerg and Protoss continued to hatch and materialize the strong men of the Zerg and Protoss, and invested in this unprecedented war!

In this way, it continued to cycle. After a period of hard fighting, with the assistance of the will of the world rules at all costs, Wu Qing led his forces and successfully eliminated all monsters!

The mysterious and terrifying power that was enough to destroy this world was also consumed, and all turned into countless strong men of the Zerg and Protoss!

After this battle, the power of the Zerg and Protoss has been increased to an unimaginable level.

The number of powerful men of great power is close to one million!

This power cannot be accommodated by this world!

This is the development and growth of the Zerg and Protoss in exchange for the system absorbing a large amount of high-quality power from outside and a large amount of origin from this world!

This world has been saved, but the will of the world rules has been weakened to the extreme, and it has to enter a deep recuperation and growth. Its control over this world has been greatly weakened!

Wu Qing gained the greatest benefit in this battle!

As long as this world can be kept from collapsing, Wu Qing doesn't care about anything else. The invasion of foreign forces will only make the Zerg and Protoss develop faster!

Let the system gain greater authority in this world!
